title: GAP Waiver Plus 150 Exclusions: Past-Due Installment Amount and the Rate Cap
content:
For a GAP Waiver Addenda Plus 150 claim, the installment amount the past-due part of the Plus excluded total uses follows the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act rate cap recorded on the Retail Installment Contracts contract. The cap is read from the latest cap-applied record and the latest cap-ended record, each being the record of its kind with the latest effective date. Where two records of one kind share that date, the one recorded first counts.

| Cap on the contract | Installment amount used |
|---|---|
| in effect on the contract's next due date and not ended by the date of loss | the installment the cap set |
| in effect on the next due date and ended on or before the date of loss | the average, over the installments treated as past due, of the cap's installment for those falling due on or before the cap's end date and the restored installment for the rest |
| any other case | not changed by the rate cap |

*Hypothetical case.* Three installments are treated as past due, and the cap ended after the first of those due dates. The cap's installment is 300.00 and the restored installment is 390.00. The amount used is 300.00 plus twice 390.00, divided by 3, which is 360.00.
